track.title: Mahur: Abol
track.notes: Open: no played pitch within 60 ¢ of the suite's finalis B (122.2 Hz); the vote picked the 4th.

album.title: The Mirza Abdollah Radif for Tar and Setar, Vol. 6

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on B3 and dwells most on E in Abol. The line peaks at F#4 (373.7 Hz) at 0:09.5. It closes on the tonic (F#4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4).
